guestBioOfficial.en: Merci Grace has been a founder, an investor (at Lightspeed Ventures), head of product and growth (at Slack), and is now a founder again (Panobi). She’s also one of the co-founders of Women in Product, and Fast Company named her one of the Most Creative People in 2017.
guestBioOfficial.zh: Merci Grace曾是创业者、Lightspeed Ventures投资人、Slack产品与增长部门主管，如今再次创业（Panobi）。她还是Women in Product的联合创始人之一，《快公司》杂志曾将她评为2017年度最具创造力人物之一。

title.en: Merci Grace (ex-Head of Growth at Slack) on PLG, interviewing, storytelling, building a diverse team, hiring salespeople, building a growth team, and much more
title.zh: Merci Grace（前Slack增长部门主管）谈产品生命周期管理、面试技巧、讲故事、组建多元化团队、招聘销售人员、建立增长团队等

summary.en: Merci explains that product-led growth still often needs sales, depending on whether the buyer needs top-down buy-in. She covers common mistakes going PLG, signs you're ready for it, and when to hire your first head of growth. The episode is a rich guide to PLG, interviewing, storytelling, and building diverse, high-performing teams.
summary.zh: 梅西阐释了：产品驱动增长（PLG）往往仍需要销售，取决于买家是否需自上而下的批准。她涵盖了做 PLG 的常见误区、何时适合 PLG，以及何时招聘第一位增长负责人。本期是关于 PLG、面试、讲故事与打造多元高效团队的丰富指南。
